name: First Tour
author: Second Credit
description: Three missions to learn the ropes: move, shoot, throw, and bring the hostages home.

intro.title: First Tour
intro.text:
Thirty volunteers queue on the hill above the camp, their boots still shiny. Four of them get a rifle today.
The jungle below has been quiet for a week, which nobody likes. The sergeant has one piece of advice: walk in single file, keep your heads down, and bring those boots back muddy. Not empty.

story.title: Huts In The Hills
story.text:
Word came down the line: the enemy has dug in on the hills past the river, and their huts turn out fresh troops faster than we can count them.
There is a crate of grenades by the ford. Flatten every hut, then clear whoever is left standing.

story.title: Bring Them Home
story.text:
Two of our scouts walked into the valley last night and never walked out. They are alive, held in the camp by the swamp.
Get in, get them to the rescue tent, and mind where you step: the ground there has been planted.

outro.title: Tour Complete
outro.text:
The squad marches back up the hill, fewer than came down, every boot caked in mud.
On the hill the new crosses stand in a neat row. The queue of volunteers is longer than ever.
